fixedPoint: HEAD b0fae5d7cbd55cb603258d830d9c2900bc351107; this shared dirty worktree was reviewed only at the laser-fence runtime hunk, event addition, scoped tests and related documentation.

findings.evidence: The canonical specification sets the link range to 5.4, while presentation still rebuilds its visible links with 1.8. Runtime can damage through a beam the player cannot see.
findings.recommendation: Move the shared range to one runtime/presentation source or update the presentation constant and add a visual-link regression test.

findings.evidence: The specification requires own-team safety. The implementation excludes the node team, but no focused test covers the behavior, and the test contract marks it as an acceptance scenario.
findings.recommendation: Add an EditMode public-scenario test that places an owner-team droid on the link and verifies unchanged HP.

findings.evidence: The specification requires transport and projectile destruction of nodes, but active nodes are not yet collision targets or portable ground objects.
findings.recommendation: Implement node lifecycle and presentation events in a separate behavior cycle; keep this weapon reported as partial until then.
